assets.de: Official transcript (Serial No. 119-44) of the House Oversight Committee's Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets hearing on UAP, 9 September 2025, chaired by Rep. Anna Paulina Luna. Witnesses: George Knapp, Jeffrey Nuccetelli, Chief Alexandro Wiggins, Dylan Borland and Joe Spielberger. Rep. Eric Burlison plays a whistleblower video of an MQ-9 firing a Hellfire missile at an orb off Yemen, 30 October 2024 (p.32).
